name: NCAA D-I Mid-Atlantic Regional Cross Country Championships
headline: NCAA D-I Mid-Atlantic Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 3 West Virginia took the top four places and won the women’s race with 19 points, led by Joy Naukot (19:19.1), with No. 24 Penn State second (83) and No. 29 Princeton third (105). No. 17 Villanova beat No. 14 Georgetown 39 to 56 for the men’s title behind a 1-2 from Bailey Habler (29:47.7) and CJ Sullivan.
